status: deployed; successful user-consented Gemini request observed

timer.cause: Step 3 alternated between Date.now minus server createdAt and elapsedSeconds from polling. Different wall clocks and response delays caused negative values and backward ticks.
timer.fix: Seed elapsed time once from the server and advance using performance.now. Clamp to nonnegative, nondecreasing integer seconds. Resumed jobs fetch a fresh elapsed value before starting their clock.

gemini.inputs: Original local image or PDF preferred; use the corresponding processed image if the original is unavailable. No arbitrary remote URLs are fetched.
gemini.consent: Only POST /ocr/jobs/<failed-job-id>/gemini/ with the existing job capability and consent=true can create a Gemini job. Regular OCR submissions cannot select the cloud engine.
gemini.retries: One child job per failed parent makes repeated POSTs idempotent. Copy completed file results and process only remaining files. Gemini failures can be retried by explicitly consenting again.
gemini.errors: Empty, unreadable, malformed or incomplete output remains an error. Authentication, quota and timeout messages do not expose provider response bodies or API credentials.
gemini.searchablePdf: No new searchable PDF is generated by Gemini; already completed local PDFs are preserved.
gemini.configurationNote: An initially empty API key is reread from the private .env file, so filling it enables the fallback without restarting active jobs. Changing an already loaded key, model or thinking level requires a service restart. GEMINI_OCR_THINKING_LEVEL defaults to medium; its value is included in the OCR cache identity.

validation.backend: 101 tests: 100 passed and one existing installed-CLI integration skip
validation.browser: Preview of the exact deployed bundle: future server timestamp and elapsed values 19 then 3 never cause backward ticks; no Gemini request before consent; one request after clicking consent; no page errors. Browser provider responses were mocked.
validation.existingLimitations: See ocr-queue-hardening-2026-11-18.json for existing legacy test and migration-check limitations.

providerObservation.source: Existing user-consented request observed during cache deployment; no additional Gemini request was made for cache verification.

transcription.qualityNote: One image, without a ground-truth transcription. Both results require review; historical Cyrillic glyph choices and some readings differ. Speed comparison does not establish equal accuracy.

mediumVerification.deployment: Private environment sets GEMINI_OCR_THINKING_LEVEL=medium; backend and worker restarted after active OCR finished; health HTTP 200. No frontend change required.
mediumVerification.rollback: Set GEMINI_OCR_THINKING_LEVEL=high and restart backend/worker when idle. Cache entries are separated by thinking level.
